Package game.crops

Class Crop

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.plants.Plant
game.crops.Crop
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Harvestable, Regressible, FreelyWaterable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Cauliflower, Melon, Parsnip, Strawberry, Tomato
public abstract class Crop extends Plant implements Harvestable, FreelyWaterable
Abstract base class for all crops.

A crop is a mature Plant that keeps track of how many times it has been watered, since several crop-specific rules (chance of damage, amount of produce, etc.) depend on that count. When a crop is removed by removeCrop(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location), e.g. after a harvest, its tile reverts to Dirt; being regressed is handled by Plant instead.

Every crop is Harvestable; the HarvestAction menu entry is offered automatically, whether the Actor is standing on the crop or on an adjacent tile. Crops that are also Waterable get the WaterAction menu entry automatically as well. Every crop also accepts a free watering (e.g. from a crow's droppings) through FreelyWaterable, independent of whether it is Waterable.
